patch.value: Realtime mutation-event subscription replaces filesystem polling as the primary out-of-band change detector

Add a per-project subscription to the pm SDK subscribeMutationEvents stream so out-of-band mutations from pm-gpt, pm-mcp, or CLI agents are surfaced within intervalMs instead of waiting for the coarse filesystem sweep. Demote the filesystem sweep to a safety net for non-pm writes (git merge, rsync restore, manual edits) by raising its default interval to 15s. Add per-item dedupe in sse.ts so this instance's own API broadcasts are skipped by the watcher without the coarse project-level window.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Created feature item and started it. Began implementation by exploring existing project-watcher.ts, sse.ts, and server.ts patterns. SDK subscribeMutationEvents API verified against installed 2026.7.25.

value.author: codex
value.text: Orchestrator verification (Claude). Reviewed the pi-authored implementation and found the source sound, but the accompanying test suite did NOT terminate: the fake subscribe generator busy-spun on setTimeout(0) whenever its queue was empty, saturating the event loop so node --test produced no output at all and could not even honour --test-timeout. Fixed by waiting out the SDK's intervalMs contract instead of a zero-delay re-check, and by unref'ing the wait timer so a subscription a test leaves running can never hold the process open. Removed the dead maybeWait/waitPromise/resolveWait scaffolding.

value.author: codex
value.text: Second defect fixed: the 'no overlapping reconciles' test asserted on resolveProjectDir call counts, but that probe is memoized per project in dirCache, so a post-unblock reconcile legitimately skips it and the test failed with 1 !== 2. The in-flight guard itself was correct. Re-probed on entries into the reconcile body (getActiveProjectIds) which is called once per non-skipped reconcile before any caching.

value.author: codex
value.text: Hardening: per-item dedupe key separator changed from a space to NUL so an itemId containing the separator can never collide across projects.

value.author: codex
value.text: Gates verified by orchestrator: npm run typecheck clean (server + frontend + sw + scripts); npm test 143/143 pass, 0 fail; the 12 new mutation-event-watcher tests pass in 619ms.

value.author: codex
value.text: END-TO-END PROOF against a real pm workspace using the BUILT dist and the REAL SDK subscription (not fakes): drove createMutationEventReconciler with intervalMs=100, then mutated the workspace from a completely separate OS process (pm update + pm notes). Both mutations were delivered as workspace-changed with data {source:mutation-events, itemId:pm-kwls, operation:update|note_add, author:harness:claude-code} and ERRORS=[]. This is exactly the pm-gpt / pm-mcp -> pm-web realtime path.
